title: Large slot Ziplock bag organizer to hang on a wall or put in a drawer; labels hard to read
text:
Large slot Ziplock bag organizer to hang on a wall or put in a drawer; labels hard to read. This is a four-compartment Ziplock bag organizer with one opening each for different types of bags such as quart, gallon, sandwich, and snack bags. Each compartment is labeled but the label is a bit hard to read since it is not colored in. This can be hung on the wall or be placed in a drawer that is large enough to hold it. There are two holes in the back but NO screws with plastic mollies provided for hanging. There are, however, four rubberized circles to place on the back to prevent this from slipping around in a drawer or scratching a wall. The bags have to be loaded through the opening and the opening is large.

This is an attractive organizer and is extremely functional. The cut of the openings is odd in spots because there's a curve but that is intentional. I'm not sure I like that look. Nevertheless, this does away with all those squished and ugly boxes in my cabinets.

The current price of $28.95 is competitively priced for this. Other options that are available for organizers like this are this [[ASIN:B09D5Y63D1 one]] if one is looking for four separate compartments. For a variety of organizers (separate and one unit), then I recommend this [[ASIN:B09KMNHM2J one]] or this [[ASIN:B09VGP1WRL one]]. For one full unit only, then I recommend this [[ASIN:B09RF759BM rustic organizer]]. For a more modern look, I recommend this [[ASIN:B09WN5PZ6Q one]]. For a larger unit that has room for foil and plastic wrap, then I highly recommend this [[ASIN:B0B1TPD21S one]]. I tried all of these and the style purchased is based on what one desires. I personally like these other ones a little better than this one.
